Name: BONFIRE_WARP_TAB_PARAM_ST
Description: Tabs of the Site of Grace warp list. Graces are grouped into subcategories (BonfireWarpSubCategoryParam), and each subcategory names the tab here that it's listed in. Only tabs that hold at least one listed grace appear.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Tab name, from Menu Text. Below 0: every grace in this tab is left out of the warp list.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Order of the tabs, ascending from the left. Retail: -1 on Roundtable Hold, so it comes first.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the tab. Retail: a distinct icon per tab (1-69).
